text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon was defeated by Tokai Teio 
in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet, amidst the roaring cheers, she feels 
glad knowing she was able to "give 
courage" to everyone watching.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even Tokai Teio praised Mihono Bourbon, 
saying her run was so incredible that it 
made her feel frustrated despite winning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, they made a promise to race each 
other again one day.
